This repository is the AI SDK provider package only. Requests about the deAPI

## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's missing or hard today?

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior or API you'd like to see.

## Scope

This package targets image generation and editing, video generation, embeddings,
speech, and transcription. Note where your request fits:

- [ ] Image generation / editing
- [ ] Video generation
- [ ] Embeddings
- [ ] Speech (text-to-speech)
- [ ] Transcription (speech-to-text)
- [ ] Other (please explain)

> Note: this provider does not offer chat/completion/tool-calling/structured-output,
> and inpainting (masks) is not available on deAPI.

## Alternatives considered

Any workarounds or alternative approaches you've thought about.

## Additional context

Links, references, or examples.
